title: C++ language server now auto-configures MSBuild builds
author: Allison
description: The Microsoft C++ Language Server for GitHub Copilot CLI now bundles its MSBuild compile commands extractor and invokes it automatically. An agent no longer needs to discover and run a… The post C++ language server now auto-configures MSBuild builds appeared first on The GitHub Blog .
summary: The Microsoft C++ Language Server for GitHub Copilot CLI now bundles its MSBuild compile commands extractor and invokes it automatically. An agent no longer needs to discover and run a separate configuration skill before it can get precise code intelligence for your project.
takeaways: What changed Previously, setting up go-to-definition, find references, and other language server features for an MSBuild-based C++ project required you to either provide your own compile_commands.json file or Copilot to locate and run a configuration skill before it could generate a compilation database.
Copilot invokes the extractor when starting the language server on project open, with no manual or agent-driven setup skill required.
An agent no longer needs to discover and run a separate configuration skill before it can get precise code intelligence for your project.
